# Expectation Setting

`customer_support.customer_communication.expectation_setting` · v0.1.0 · **draft** · **STUB**

**What can we honestly commit to here, and what happens when it slips?**


> Deciding what to promise, knowing that every promise becomes a clock somebody has to answer to. The expensive mistake is optimism offered to end an uncomfortable exchange: an under-promise that lands early costs nothing, while an over-promise turns a solvable ticket into a broken one and hands the next agent a trust problem stacked on top of the original fault. Expectations are set against what the queue actually does, not against what the entitlement document says it does — and a promise made without saying what happens if it slips is only half a promise.
